editing_style: Fast-paced with loose rhythm, prioritizing human moments over aesthetics, with a warm nostalgic ending.
emotional_intent: To evoke a sense of fun, energy, and nostalgia for university friendships.
plan_summary: This edit uses a 5-segment arc intro sets the scene with lively group moments, build-up escalates with action and celebration, peak delivers the most energetic clips, transition eases into a warmer tone, and outro slows down with a single, cherished memory of friends together.
arc_description: Energy rises from moderate to high, peaks in the middle, then gradually cools into a warm, nostalgic outro.
narrative_message: University is about shared moments of joy with friends.

segments.reasoning: Open with quick cuts of friends laughing and hanging out (e.g., car vlog, elevator) to immediately establish the joyful, energetic tone.
Increase energy with action shots like water fights and celebration dancing, building towards the music peak at ~7s.
The loudest moment of the music aligns with the most energetic clips (water fight, foam spray, balancing stunts) for maximum impact.
Slightly reduce intensity with clips of friends laughing together in relaxed settings (car, safety net) to prepare for the outro.
Slow down with a single, cherished clip of friends together (e.g., lounging on a safety net or laughing in a car) held long, with warm color grading to evoke a fond memory.

text_prompt:
Creator intent Show the fun and energy of university life with friends in a quick, happy edit.
Output feel Fun, energetic, happy, nostalgic.
Subject priority Mixed - friends and campus scenery.
Pacing curve Fast-paced with quick cuts, but loose rhythm to follow natural energy.
Clip selection priorities Prefer clips of friends laughing, goofing around, group activities, action shots, scenic campus shots, variety of settings. Avoid slow or sad moments, clips without friends, long static shots, overly polished footage.
Quality tolerance Moment over quality - shaky or low-light clips are acceptable if they show a great moment.
Avoid Slow or sad moments, clips without friends, long static shots, overly polished or staged footage.
Text/caption direction Overlay caption like Uni days in a fun, casual font, maybe animated.
Music sync Looser, more natural rhythm, not strictly beat-locked.
Ending Slow down with a warm memory - final clip should be a calm, nostalgic moment.
Blueprint bias Use dense cuts for high energy but allow some holds for scenic shots. Keep transitions simple. Prioritize human moments over aesthetics. Make the blueprint fit real uploaded clips and treat requested shots as preferences.
Resolved user choices Mix of friends and campus scenery, moment over quality, slow down ending, loose rhythm sync.
Subject priority mixed
Clip selection priorities human moments and motion
Quality tolerance moment over quality
Text/caption direction literal with overlay text like Uni days
Music sync loose rhythm
Ending slow down with a warm memory
